title: Taipei Futai Street Mansion

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation on the Yanping frontage at the arcade approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Native OpenStreetMap named footprint, matched to the City of Taipei address and heritage description.
mapIdentity.scope: Named native four-corner outline at 26 Yanping South Road; municipal descriptions establish a public stone arcade, upper timber floor, and three-dormer mansard.

note: Original public terrain fixes the street datum. The upper-floor, stone arch and roof shapes are reconstructed using the written source details. Dimensions are estimates within the mapped envelope.
